At sampling temperature 1.0, **DPO wins about 39% of the time and PPO about 7%**. Both numbers are my readings from Figure 2 (right) on page 7. The paper gives no exact values at this temperature, so treat them as approximate (±~0.01).

- **DPO ≈ 0.38–0.39.** This is its lowest point on the plot, down from about 0.62 at temperature 0.0 (p. 7).
- **PPO ≈ 0.07.** This is almost the same as the base GPT-J model (about 0.06) at that temperature (p. 7).

What the paper says in the text supports these readings:
- DPO's win rate is about 61% at temperature 0.0, compared with 57% for PPO at its best temperature, also 0.0 (p. 9).
- DPO is "much more robust to the sampling temperature than PPO, the performance of which can degrade to that of the base GPT-J model at high temperatures" (p. 9).
- The figure caption says DPO is "more robust to changes in the sampling temperature" (p. 7).

The PDF's text layer has no data points for this plot, so I rendered page 7 as an image and read the values off the chart.
